defs.name: clickable-pr-links
defs.say: PR and issue references must be clickable links — a PR is https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/pull/<n> (e.g. https://github.com/sverka-dev/sverka/pull/123), an issue is https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n>; never a bare #123.
